Ecode.source: Health79_legacy.pdf (全國性預防接種資料庫, 2019-05-22 修訂), section 三「欄位（變項）譯碼表」1. 疫苗名稱劑次（Ecode）, PDF pages 3-6; pages rendered to images and transcribed visually because the PDF text layer is garbled (broken font encoding drops the Chinese labels).
Ecode.note: 代碼前的「+」表示補種／補打；代碼尾數為劑次。Codes prefixed with "+" are catch-up doses; a trailing number is the dose number. The ★ on HepB-LBW is printed in the manual without explanation.
